guarantees.claim: For each share index i < Share, theta_data[i] is continuously assigned the return value of function theta(phase1_in[i]).
For each share index i < Share, pi_data[i] is continuously assigned the return value of function pi(rho_data[i]).

assumptions.claim: External logic must provide rho_data[i] that correctly implements the Keccak rho function (expected as rho(theta_data[i])) for each share i, because this chunk uses rho_data directly to compute pi_data.
assumptions.risk: If rho_data is not provided or is incorrect, pi_data will be erroneous, breaking the Keccak permutation and leading to incorrect hash output, a security integrity failure.

uncertain_points.claim: rho_data is consumed here for pi computation, but its assignment via the rho function is commented out; the origin of rho_data must be verified to ensure it implements the correct Keccak rho transform for each share.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect or missing rho_data will corrupt the Keccak state and compromise the hash or digest integrity/security.

uncertain_points.claim: The commented-out rho assignment mentions VCS error due to non-constant (z-Offset%W); if this issue persists in the external rho_data generation, synthesis or parameter-dependent failures are possible.
uncertain_points.cond: when parameters cause non-constant shift amount
uncertain_points.risk: Unreliable rho_data generation can break the Keccak datapath.
